title: Influence of light spectrum and photoperiod on early seedling development and microgreen yield in cabbage (Brassica oleracea var. capitata) and arugula (Eruca sativa)
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00947B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Christos Vatistas, Dafni Despoina Avgoustaki, Thomas Bartzanas
A two-stage lighting strategy is proposed, combining early light treatment to enhance seedling emergence with a second stage to promote biomass accumulation, improving overall microgreens production.
